summary.text: Brenda Sanders is the Green Party candidate on the November ballot for Michigan's 12th District. A Detroit attorney, she served as a judge of the 36th District Court and was the Green Party nominee in this district in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Earned an undergraduate degree from the University of Michigan in 1980 and a J.D. from the University of Detroit Mercy School of Law in 1983.
Practiced law in Detroit for 24 years, specializing in criminal, family, civil litigation and church law, and served as house counsel for the 36th District Court.
Served as a judge of the Michigan 36th District Court; she ran for re-election unopposed in 2014.
Ran as the Green Party candidate for this district in 2024, receiving 2.3% of the vote; nominated again at the Green Party convention on July 18, 2026.
